title: clinopodium urticifolium
intro: Clinopodium urticifolium, commonly known as Kalmegh, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kalmegh include treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents may contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions.
